name: Duration Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the duration of the delivery period.

SEAS.name: Season
SEAS.definition: Event takes place every six months or two times a year.

QURT.name: Quarter
QURT.definition: Event takes place every three months or four times a year.

MNTH.name: Month
MNTH.definition: Event takes place every month or once a month.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Duration is expressed in another unit.
